question: Which city bagged the first rank as the cleanest city of India under Swachh Survekshan League 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indore** was named **India's Cleanest City for the fifth yea**r in a row by **Swachh Survekshan**, with** Surat and Vijayawada taking second and third place** in the more than 1 lakh people category, respectively.
 
• Vita, Lonavala, and Sasvad, all in Maharashtra, took first, second, and third place in the population category of "less than 1 lakh" accordingly.
 
• **Varanasi **was named** 'Best Ganga Town,' **and** Ahmedabad Cantonment** was named 'India's Cleanest Cantonment,' ahead of Meerut Cantonment and Delhi Cantonment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Union Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**(MoHUA) has released the** Swachh Survekshan 2020** report.
 
• The annual cleanliness urban study undertaken by the MoHUA is in its fifth year.
 
• It is one of the largest sanitation surveys in the world. **Swachh Survekshan** is a ranking exercise undertaken by the Indian government to analyze the cleanliness of rural and urban areas, as well as the prompt and inventive execution of Swachhata's mission efforts.
 
• The survey's goal is to stimulate widespread public participation and raise awareness among all segments of society about the significance of working together to make cities and towns more livable.
